name: Have I Been Pwned
summary: Data breach search: check whether an email address appears in 1,000+ breached sites, with alerts, API and MCP access.
description: Check whether an email address appears in known data breaches; results show a timeline of breaches, the data classes exposed and paste records from public text dumps. Alerts notify you when the address shows up in future breaches. A REST API and an MCP server give developers and AI agents programmatic access, with public breach metadata and Pwned Passwords (k-anonymity) available without signing in.
contains: breach timeline and exposed data classes per email address
paste records from public text dumps
Notify Me alerts for future breaches
Pwned Passwords range search with k-anonymity
MCP server at /mcp for AI agents (OAuth)
